title: Asynchronous enterprise security triage: prioritized risk matrix + handoff workflow
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a lightweight, async-first triage workflow and a prioritized risk matrix to route incoming customer security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires) into Product, Security, Legal, or Solutions teams. Reduce time-to-routing for high-impact requests and provide clear SLAs, required artifacts, and auto-assign rules for repeated questionnaire types.
acceptance_criteria: A documented risk matrix mapping request attributes (data residency, PHI exposure, contractual terms, audit requests) to priority buckets (Critical/High/Medium/Low) exists and is reviewed by Security & Legal.
An async triage playbook with explicit routing rules and required artifacts per bucket is published in Confluence and linked from Support and Sales intake forms.
Automation rules (Zapier/Workato/low-code) prototypes that tag and route intake emails/forms based on keywords and checkbox metadata are validated with two real customer examples.
SLA targets defined per bucket (e.g., Critical: 24h response, High: 72h, Medium: 10 business days) and instrumented in the intake dashboard.
Two pilot accounts (enterprise customers) use the workflow for at least one live questionnaire and provide feedback scoring >= 4/5 for clarity and speed.
A rollout plan with training materials for Sales/Support and a single-point remediation path for escalations is created.
A list of sensitive artifacts and minimum templates (DPA checklist, SOC2 evidence mapping, HIPAA data flow diagram) is attached to the playbook.
scope: Design and publish the triage matrix + async routing playbook; implement low-friction automation for auto-tagging; pilot with two enterprise customers; update intake form links and training materials.
out_of_scope: Full engineering implementation of intake automation in Redwood Console; revamping Legal contract templates (Legal to own); building a case management module in the Console (future work).
success_metrics: Median time-to-first-response for security intake decreases from 6 business days to <72 hours for High requests during pilot
% of requests correctly auto-routed to the owning team >= 85% during pilot
Reduction in back-and-forth clarification requests by >=30% for common questionnaire types
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize risk matrix + playbook and review with Security & Legal. Week 2: Implement simple automation prototype for tagging; create Confluence docs and intake form updates. Week 3: Pilot with two customers; collect feedback. Week 4: Iterate and expand to Support and Sales teams; schedule training session and record onboarding video.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Legal review delays — Mitigation: Pre-schedule blocking review sessions and provide Legal with a condensed change log and evidence artifacts.
Risk: Over-automation misclassifying nuanced asks — Mitigation: Start with conservative rules and require human verification for Critical/High buckets.
Risk: Lack of adoption by Sales/Support — Mitigation: Keep playbook concise, attach one-page cheat sheet, and embed links inside their existing tools (not a separate app).
